description: Returns the current page view of an open audit without doing anything. By default in full: every element and the whole page text.

detail.description: Default full here. compact (default for browser_action): up to 40 elements above or below the screen, and the page text or element list replaced by a note when unchanged since the last view. full: every element and the whole text again.

name: get_page
title: Show the current page
